title: Under-resourced studies of under-resourced languages: lemmatization and POS-tagging with LLM annotators for historical Armenian, Georgian, Greek and Syriac
reasoning: The paper's benchmark datasets are exclusively composed of historical religious texts from the Christian East, including genres such as patristics, homiletics, exegesis, hagiography, and theology. The study evaluates the linguistic performance of LLMs specifically within these religious and theological domains.
